text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Most of the coffee beans that make it
into our
cup are either arabica or
robusta.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Robusta beans are bitter... and have a
unique
flavor. But when you blend them
with arabica
beans, they add a nice
accent to the flavor.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Every bean can shine given the right

environment... Coffee teaches us
kindness.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you like... to join me for a cup?
